synthesis.paragraph: Three of today's papers carry the tag "Urban Green Space and Health", examining the impact of nature connectedness on loneliness among university students, evaluating cross-platform consistency in street view imagery for urban perception mapping, and analyzing divergent approaches to the professional governance of arborists and urban foresters in Canada. Outside of this group, another paper developed a hybrid GA-BPNN model with a Bayesian updating mechanism to predict the pavement quality index. Additionally, a systematic review analyzed 2,253 studies to evaluate disability-inclusive intelligent transportation systems, while a final study used fieldwork in Beijing's Dashilar neighborhood to analyze how actors negotiate temporalities and heritage during urban regeneration.
